svg.title: Switch, single-pole double-throw
svg.desc: Switch, single-pole double-throw, IEEE 315-1975 §4.6.2 switch, double-throw; §4.3.3 transfer contact, blade form. Not in the Schematex circuit exemplar; drawn to its rules with pins on the engine's anchors; one unit is one exemplar pixel. Pins: common (37,8), normally closed (61,108), normally open (13,108).
